nodes.text:
Sit. No - you're fine. I can tell from here, I've had the practice.

Healing, mana, vigor. Bigger measures than you'll find inland, because down here things hit harder and you're further from anyone who cares.

Nothing, any more. There's no one left to have granted it and no one left to take it back, so I've kept it.

I was studying drowning. Properly, I mean - what the body does, how long it takes, whether it can be walked back. Then the Reach gave me rather more material than I'd asked for and I stopped enjoying the work.
